## Meaning

This monitor fired because the signal changed faster than the configured percentage relative to its own recent history. Speed of degradation, not absolute level.

Query:

```
pct_change(avg(last_15m),last_1h):p99:trace.http.request.duration{__SCOPE__} by {service} > 100
```

## Impact

The service still functions but measurably worse; a subset of traffic or users is failing.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-api-latency`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `diag-api-health` (diagnostic only) runs automatically on every alert.

Actions: `fetch_monitor`, `top_failing_endpoints`, `upstream_status`, `rate_limit_state`.

Attached to the alert automatically: top failing routes, upstream health, current rate-limit headroom.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `application-development` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `sre`.
3. Priority contract: P2, P3 — ack within 10 minutes, escalate at 20.
